{"path":"/results/10_feb_melting/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/task/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_trial_4/silicon_melting.in","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units metal

# Read data file
read_data silicon_structure.data

# Define interatomic potential

# Replicate the structure
replicate 3 3 3

# Define settings for NPT ensemble

run 500000  # 500,000 timesteps for equilibration (500 ps)

# Output settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient
compute msd all msd
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[4] file msd.txt mode vector

# End of script"}
